transaction_items.subject: Máximo Martínez / White Sox 2023
transaction_items.current_state: INCOMING INTERNATIONAL_BONUS_POOL_SPACE asset 499cd8c7 with NULL amount, plus FUTURE_CONSIDERATIONS asset 0697dc03; queue POOL_SPACE_AMOUNT_UNKNOWN and FUTURE_CONSIDERATIONS_UNRESOLVED.
transaction_items.why: The cited page says "The amount of international slot money the Dodgers received was not announced, but teams are required to trade it in increments of $250,000". The $1,410,000 in the text is the White Sox total pool as of June 11, not the amount traded. The source does not give roughly $1.4M. Separately, pool_space_amount_usd is exact numeric(14,2) with no amount-quality field, so an approximate figure could not be stored as approximate even if it were sourced.
transaction_items.smallest_honest_fix: A source that states the amount traded. If it is only approximate, the smallest honest solution is an amount-quality marker (for example an amount_quality column or an evidence note); that is a schema or convention change and is not proposed.
